caption: The drawing depicts a single teapot centered on a plain, light-colored background. The teapot is rendered in shades of black, gray, and white, giving it a monochromatic appearance. It features an ornate design with a ribbed body, a wide rounded base, and a narrow neck that expands into a slightly flared rim. The spout extends prominently to the left side of the composition, curving outward, while a large, curved handle is attached to the right. The teapot is topped with a domed lid, which also has a ribbed pattern and a rounded knob at the top. The shading suggests a metallic or ceramic surface, and the overall style is detailed, with emphasis on the contours and highlights of the object. At the lower right of the drawing, the name "Samuel O. Klein" appears in small print.
title: Teapot
